name: Janina Kutyn
bio: Janina has worked across the tech spectrum: from scrappy startups to global brands like adidas and ING, and she even spent six years at Apple building products like Apple Music and the TV App. Now as an indie developer working on Lupin, she's interested in creating apps that are not only beautiful and high-performing, but also make a positive social impact. When she's not writing software, she's writing children's books.
